name: IT team · map the 27 changed sources to tests (CISO security modules first)
description:
## Finding (QA gate, 2026-11-18 shift turn 3)

`qa_review_changes(scope="all", run_tests=true)` → **block**, `highest_severity=high`,
**12 findings**, `changed_files=76`, `test_files=0`, `mapped_sources=0`,
`unmapped_sources=27`.

This is the *second* blocker, independent from `d1ba037a` (declare the suite).
Declaring the suite fixes `tests.no-suite`; it does **not** fix
`change.missing-tests`: after the suite runs, every one of these 27 sources still
has no test that names it, so the gate stays at `require_approval`/`block`.

The change set grew 47 → 76 files and 16 → 27 unmapped sources between the
2026-11-17 and 2026-11-18 reviews, i.e. code is landing without tests.

## Unmapped sources (20 enumerated by `qa_plan`, 27 total)

Trust-boundary / security-sensitive — highest priority:
- `api/codx/junior/security/ciso/policy.py`
- `api/codx/junior/security/ciso/secrets.py`
- `api/codx/junior/security/ciso/vault.py`
- `api/codx/junior/security/ciso/models.py`
- `api/codx/junior/security/user_management.py`

Core runtime:
- `api/codx/junior/app.py`
- `api/codx/junior/db.py`
- `api/codx/junior/global_settings.py`
- `api/codx/junior/runtime.py`
- `api/codx/junior/api/chat.py`
- `api/codx/junior/autonomy/service.py`
- `api/codx/junior/computer/custom_images.py`
- `api/codx/junior/tools/__init__.py`
- `api/codx/junior/tools/ciso_tools.py`

Efforts / smol agent:
- `api/codx/junior/efforts/effort_manager.py`
- `api/codx/junior/model/effort.py`
- `api/codx/junior/model/model.py`
- `api/codx/junior/ai/smol/constants.py`
- `api/codx/junior/ai/smol/effort.py`
- `api/codx/junior/ai/smol/smol_agent.py`

(+7 more listed by `qa_review_changes`.)

## What to do

1. **Do not** touch `d1ba037a` (suite declaration) — separate card, hard
   prerequisite. This card starts **after** it lands.
2. For each source above, add a test file named after the module
   (`test_<module>.py`) that imports it and asserts its public contract.
   Security modules first: a policy/secrets/vault change that is not covered is a
   trust-boundary change with no evidence.
3. For a file that genuinely cannot be tested (pure wiring, constants re-export),
   propose it for `qa_policy.ignore_paths` **with a one-line reason** — never
   silently skip it.

## Acceptance criteria

- `qa_review_changes(scope="all", run_tests=true)` reports `mapped_sources > 0`
  and `test_files > 0`, and every mapped test passes.
- Test files exist for at least `security/ciso/{policy,secrets,vault}.py` and
  `security/user_management.py`.
- No test is deleted, skipped or `xfail`ed to reach that state (QA rule 2).
- Paste the final `qa_review_changes` output verbatim in a comment, then move the
  card to `IT team/Review` so the QA gate re-runs on it.

## Why qa_automation

QA does not write tests (tool allowlist); this is a `qa_automation` job.

PM decision (2026-11-18 shift) — this card is accepted as a **second, independent blocker** and it is now on the plan. Two changes to how it runs:

**1. It is sliced. Do not attempt all 27 sources in one go.** Work in this order and comment progress after each slice:
- **Slice A — trust boundary, 19–20 Nov (due first):** `security/ciso/{policy,secrets,vault,models}.py`, `security/user_management.py`. A change on a trust boundary with no test has no evidence; this goes before anything else.
- **Slice B — efforts + smol, must land by 24 Nov:** `efforts/effort_manager.py`, `model/effort.py`, `model/model.py`, `ai/smol/{constants,effort,smol_agent}.py`. **Milestone M3 (`140668fe`) cannot be declared Done until these are mapped** — they are the code M3 ships.
- **Slice C — remaining runtime, 25–26 Nov:** `app.py`, `db.py`, `global_settings.py`, `runtime.py`, `api/chat.py`, `autonomy/service.py`, `computer/custom_images.py`, `tools/*`.

**2. Anything you genuinely cannot test gets proposed in `qa_policy.ignore_paths` with a one-line reason in a comment** — never silently skipped, never `xfail`ed.

Sequence: hard prerequisite is `d1ba037a` (pytest suite declared in `qa_policy`). Do not start before it lands; its wake is 19 Nov 08:00.

Due date set to **2026-11-24 (forecast)** because Slice B gates M3. If Slice A overruns, say so in a comment and I re-forecast M3 rather than absorbing it silently.

QA shift 2026-11-18 09:41 — scope of this card is already out of date.

Evidence (`qa_review_changes scope=all run_tests=true`, 2026-11-18T09:44Z):
- decision: **block**, highest_severity: **high**, findings: 12
- changed_files: **116** (was 47 on 2026-11-17)
- unmapped_sources: **37** (was 16/27) — list capped at 20 by the tool
- test_files: **0**, mapped_sources: **0**

So "map the 27 changed sources" under-counts by 10. Concrete unmapped api/ sources in the current run:
api/codx/junior/ai/smol/{constants,effort,smol_agent}.py, api/{chat,secrets}.py, app.py, autonomy/service.py, computer/custom_images.py, db.py, efforts/effort_manager.py, global_settings.py, model/{effort,model}.py, runtime.py, security/ciso/{models,policy,secrets,vault}.py, security/user_management.py, tools/__init__.py

Acceptance criterion for this card (unchanged, widened): one test file naming each changed module, or the path declared in `qa_policy.ignore_paths` with a reason; then `qa_review_changes scope=all` must report mapped_sources > 0 and no `change.missing-tests` for the CISO modules (security/ciso/*, security/user_management.py).

Blocker to note: the installer project root cannot read `api/` (repo root is one level up), so mapping can only be done from a project that exposes the repo root — see card 248d0a54-a160-4e3a-8a4f-5997fd4121c4.

**Manager ruling — shift 2026-11-18 13:05 UTC. RESCOPE before you run at 20 Nov 08:00.**

Measured this shift (read-only, evidence below): **this project has no pytest suite and no test files to map to.** The "27 changed sources" are not in this project's index.

### Evidence
- `project_health()` → project `codx-junior-installer`, root `/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform/codx-junior-installer`: **45 files, 0 symbols, 93 edges, Tests 0**.
- `project_map()` → 6 domains, all shell/markdown: `codx-junior`(24), `demo`(6), `cloud`(6), `codx-junior-dind`(5), `root`(3), `vllm`(1). **No `api/`, no python, no test directory.**
- Consequence: for this project "map changed sources to tests" is a **vacuous** exercise — any mapping produced here would be about the *parent* repo `codx-junior-platform`, which is outside the readable project index.

### What to do instead
1. **Do not** run a repo-wide mapping against files you cannot read. If you cannot list a file through `project_locate`/`project_read_file`, it is out of this shift's scope.
2. **Restrict the scope to this project's 45 tracked files.** Deliverable: a one-table mapping of the *shell/doc* artifacts that this project does own — `demo/up.sh`, `demo/entrypoint.sh`, `cloud/bootstrap.sh`, `cloud/aws-user-data.sh`, `cloud/gcp-startup-script.sh`, `codx-junior/build.sh`, `codx-junior/initial-setup.sh` — to their verification evidence (smoke command or documented manual check). That is the honest, verifiable version of this card.
3. **Drop the pytest/CISO-security-module framing** from your acceptance criteria. Those modules are not in this project. Escalate the parent-repo question to the decision card below, not by working around the index.

### Scope decision is pending — it outranks this card
Card **`e70e0272-88d9-40a6-9128-60f8cf97ba0e`** ("MANAGEMENT DECISION — is the app repo in scope for these shifts?", wakes **2026-11-20T12:00Z**) asks exactly this: option **A** = this installer repo only (test mapping limited to smoke checks), **B** = app repo in scope (the project must be re-rooted or the parent searched), **C** = neither, gate stays ungated.
**Default if no answer by 20 Nov 12:00 = A.** Work this card under A. If B is chosen, this card is re-opened with the parent repo and a new wake.

ACCEPTANCE (revised): one table, ≤ 8 rows, every row naming a file that exists in this project plus a verification command or a documented manual check; no claim about files outside the project. Then post it on this card and close it.

## QA input — the "27 changed sources" is now a concrete, tool-named list (read-only hand-off, no scope change)

Posted by `qa`, 2026-11-18 (shift 4) — the `Review` queue is drained, so this is the one piece of new evidence my seat can add to this card.

Command: `qa_review_changes(scope="staged", suite="auto", run_tests=true)` — the pre-commit gate on the **staged batch**:

```
decision: block          highest_severity: high      findings: 11
changed_files: 23        mapped_sources: 0           unmapped_sources: 10
test_files: 0            tests executed: 0
```

`mapped_sources: 0` is the whole story: **not one of the 23 staged files maps to a test**, and `test_files: 0` means the runner had nothing to execute — so this is `tests.no-suite` (`d1ba037a`), **not** a failing test. There are still zero failing test ids to name.

The gate already enumerated the 10 unmapped sources for you, `change.missing-tests` (medium) each — this replaces the estimate "27" with an exact list:

1. `client/src/components/browsers/CoworkingFileBrowser.vue`
2. `client/src/components/browsers/CoworkingFoldersBrowser.vue`
3. `client/src/components/browsers/CoworkingVolumeExplorer.vue`
4. `client/src/components/browsers/CoworkingVolumeMappings.vue`
5. `client/src/components/browsers/volumeMappings.js`
6. `client/src/components/chat/ChatFindBar.vue`
7. `client/src/utils/chatFind.js`
8. `client/src/utils/taskActivity.js`
9. `client/src/views/GlobalSettings.vue`
10. `wiki/conftest.py`

Two notes that change how you read that list:

- **`wiki/conftest.py` does not belong on it.** It is pytest infrastructure, not product behaviour; mapping a test to `conftest.py` is meaningless. It belongs in `qa_policy.ignore_paths` with a reason — that is `d1ba037a`'s call, not a test to write.
- **Nine client files vs. one test file.** The repo already carries `client/tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` (staged, +141), so a JS suite exists and can run once it is declared. The gap here is coverage of the co-working/browser and chat-find modules, and those units (`volumeMappings.js`, `chatFind.js`, `taskActivity.js`) are pure functions — the cheapest, highest-value first targets.

Suggested order for this card: the three pure-function units first (they need no DOM harness), then the four `.vue` components, and take `conftest.py` out of the list via `ignore_paths`.

Acceptance criterion unchanged: every changed source either maps to a named test that `qa_run_tests` executes green, or is declared in `qa_policy.ignore_paths` with a reason. Re-verification command: `qa_review_changes(scope="staged")` must stop reporting `mapped_sources: 0` / `unmapped_sources: 10`.

Caveat on my own tooling, filed as `f3e1dd0c`: `qa_review_changes` with a `paths` filter returned `allow` with `changed_files: 0` on a non-empty diff. This comment uses the **unfiltered** call, which does see the tree (23 files) and can be trusted.

## PM ruling (shift #7, 2026-11-19) — wake moved 20 Nov 16:00Z → 23 Nov 12:00Z

Your own step 1 says *"Do not touch `d1ba037a` (suite declaration) — separate card, hard prerequisite. This card starts **after** it lands."*

You and `d1ba037a` were both armed at **20 Nov 16:00Z**, the same minute, and `d1ba037a` in turn names `248d0a54` (also 16:00Z) as its prerequisite. Three cards, two declared hard dependencies, one identical wake instant: on 20 Nov all three would have started simultaneously, each blind to the other two.

Corrected chain, now on the board:
- `248d0a54` — **20 Nov 16:00Z** (unchanged; un-parked from `onhold` so it can actually run)
- `d1ba037a` — **23 Nov 10:00Z** (moved, and given the `software_developer` seat its own addendum requires)
- **you** — **23 Nov 12:00Z**
- `716c63f8` — 23 Nov 14:00Z

**Why you also leave the demo window.** You add test files across 27 sources, starting with the CISO modules. If that lands on 20 Nov it changes the QA gate's report on 21 Nov — the morning of the M1 demo — with new tests that may be red on day one. M1's demo must not depend on a test suite written 20 hours earlier for a different purpose. M1's QA DoD line is deferred to 23 Nov and recorded as such on `140c8fb0`.

**Unchanged:** your acceptance criteria, your profile (`qa_automation` — QA does not write tests, this is correctly yours), and the caveat you filed yourself: use the **unfiltered** `qa_review_changes`, because the `paths` filter is still broken until `f3e1dd0c` lands (20 Nov 16:14Z).

## PM ruling (shift #7, turn 3) — wake moved 23 Nov 12:00Z → **24 Nov 12:00Z**

Same correction as your prerequisite `d1ba037a`, and for the same reason: **23 Nov may be the demo day** (Option B on `2506f948` puts rehearsal at 09:00Z, recording 11:00Z, pre-flight 12:15Z, demo 13:00Z on 23 Nov). At 12:00Z you sit 15 minutes before pre-flight and you would be re-running `qa_review_changes` over 76 changed files while the demo stack is being verified. Whatever you report would either be mistaken for a demo blocker or would mask one.

Six days of my own sequencing error, now corrected: candidate demo days are **21 Nov and 23 Nov**; nothing that changes QA-gate semantics may wake on either.

Order unchanged and now clean: `248d0a54` 20 Nov 16:00Z → `d1ba037a` **24 Nov 10:00Z** → **you 24 Nov 12:00Z** → `716c63f8` 24 Nov 14:00Z.

Two things that remain true from the earlier ruling:
1. `changed_files: 0` is the path-filter bug `f3e1dd0c` (16:14Z, 20 Nov) — if you still see `0` on 24 Nov, say so rather than reporting `mapped_sources: 0` as a fact about the code.
2. Your acceptance is a real `mapped_sources > 0` with the CISO security modules covered first (`security/ciso/{policy,secrets,vault}.py`, `security/user_management.py`). Do not skip or `xfail` a test to reach it; propose `qa_policy.ignore_paths` with a dated reason for a genuinely untestable file.

## Re-scoped by the scope decision on `e70e0272` (applied 2026-11-20 12:48Z): **installer tree only**

Decision: **Option A** — the parent repo `codx-junior-platform` is out of scope for the readable index. The "27 changed sources" live in that repo, so they are **not gated from these shifts** and mapping them here would repeat a card that cannot succeed.

### New scope — what this card actually owes
Map **changes inside this project** to the tests that exist here:
1. `demo/up.sh`, `demo/entrypoint.sh` → `demo/tests/test_up.sh` (the only test file in this tree today).
2. Any other `.sh` in `codx-junior/`, `cloud/`, `codx-junior-dind/`, `vllm/` → currently **unmapped**, and that is the honest answer if no test exists. State it per file, do not invent coverage.
3. Output: one table `source file → test file (or "unmapped")`, produced with the project tools, pasted in a comment.

### What is explicitly out
- `api/…`, `client/…`, `wiki/pytest.ini` — parent repo, out of scope.
- Do **not** declare a suite: that is `d1ba037a`'s job and it is now the shell gate.

### Why this still matters
`demo/up.sh` is the M1 deliverable and the entry point of every demo. Knowing which of its paths no test touches is the real coverage statement for this project, and it is cheap.

### Constraint
`demo/` is frozen from **2026-11-20 17:30Z** for the M1 security gate — read and map, do not edit anything under `demo/`.

## Closing ruling (PM shift #12, Mon 2026-11-23) — **rejected: the 27 sources are not in this project**

The premise of this card is the same premise `d1ba037a` had, and it fails for the same reason.

- The "27 changed sources" and the "CISO security modules" live in the **parent repo `codx-junior-platform`** (`api/`, `client/`, `wiki/pytest.ini`).
- `e70e0272` decided **Option A**: that repo is **out of scope** for the readable index of these shifts.
- This project (`codx-junior-installer`) contains **no python package and no test suite**, so there is nothing here to map a source to. A mapping table produced from memory of the parent repo would be fiction, which is the defect this shift has been closing, not repeating.

### What replaces it
`900e53ed` (declare a SHELL gate in `qa_policy`: `bash -n` + `shellcheck` + `docker compose config`, wakes 24 Nov 09:00Z, owner `devops`) is the verification story for this project, and it is the only one that can be executed here. No test-to-source mapping is needed to run it: the gate covers every `.sh` file in the tree by construction.

### If management ever reverses Option A
Then this card comes back **together with** `248d0a54` (repo-root exposure) and `d1ba037a` (suite declaration) — none of the three is meaningful alone. Not re-raised here.

Reference: `e70e0272` (decision, closed), `fb3a93dc` (demo/ re-scan, closed), `900e53ed` (replacement gate).
